question: Quais são os 10 principais motivos de internação para pacientes com menos de 18 anos, entre 18 e 64 anos, e acima de 64 anos?
baseline_sql: SELECT faixa_etaria, motivo_internacao, total_internacoes FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN i."IDADE" < 18 THEN 'Menor de 18' WHEN i."IDADE" BETWEEN 18 AND 64 THEN '18 a 64' ELSE '65 ou mais' END AS faixa_etaria, c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS motivo_internacao, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN i."IDADE" < 18 THEN 'Menor de 18' WHEN i."IDADE" BETWEEN 18 AND 64 THEN '18 a 64' ELSE '65 ou mais' END ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."IDADE" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY faixa_etaria, c."CD_DESCRICAO" ) sub WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY faixa_etaria, rn;
comparison_sql: SELECT faixa_etaria, motivo_internacao, total FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN "IDADE" < 18 THEN 'Menor de 18' WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 18 AND 64 THEN '18 a 64' ELSE '65 ou mais' END AS faixa_etaria, c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS motivo_internacao, COUNT(*) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN "IDADE" < 18 THEN 'Menor de 18' WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 18 AND 64 THEN '18 a 64' ELSE '65 ou mais' END ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" GROUP BY faixa_etaria, c."CD_DESCRICAO" ) sub WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY faixa_etaria, total DESC;

question: Como se distribuem os hospitais em quartis de volume de internações? Mostre o número de hospitais e o intervalo de internações por quartil.
baseline_sql: WITH hospital_volume AS ( SELECT i."CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i GROUP BY i."CNES" ), quartis AS ( SELECT "CNES", total_internacoes, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_internacoes) AS quartil FROM hospital_volume ) SELECT quartil, COUNT(*) AS numero_hospitais, MIN(total_internacoes) AS intervalo_minimo, MAX(total_internacoes) AS intervalo_maximo FROM quartis GROUP BY quartil, "CNES" ORDER BY quartil;
comparison_sql: WITH hospital_volume AS ( SELECT i."CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i GROUP BY i."CNES" ), quartis AS ( SELECT "CNES", total_internacoes, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_internacoes) AS quartil FROM hospital_volume ) SELECT quartil, COUNT(*) AS numero_hospitais, MIN(total_internacoes) AS intervalo_inferior, MAX(total_internacoes) AS intervalo_superior FROM quartis GROUP BY quartil ORDER BY quartil;

question: Quais municípios com mais de 1000 internações têm taxa de internação em UTI mais de duas vezes acima da média nacional?
baseline_sql: WITH media_nacional AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_ref FROM internacoes ), por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu."nome" AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" GROUP BY mu."nome" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ) SELECT pm."municipio", pm."total_internacoes", ROUND(pm."taxa_uti", 2) AS taxa_internacao_uti FROM por_municipio pm, media_nacional mn WHERE pm."taxa_uti" > mn."taxa_ref" * 2 ORDER BY taxa_internacao_uti DESC;
comparison_sql: WITH media_nacional AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_ref FROM internacoes ), por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu."nome" AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" GROUP BY mu."nome" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ) SELECT pm.municipio, pm.total_internacoes, ROUND(pm.taxa_uti, 2) AS taxa_internacao_uti FROM por_municipio pm, media_nacional mn WHERE pm.taxa_uti > mn.taxa_ref * 2 ORDER BY taxa_internacao_uti DESC;
